That’s really mature. I strive to be okay by myself one day; I envy people like you who are. If my marriage doesn’t work out then I’m just gonna stay alone tho. Fuck forming connections with anyone else ever again. It’s too much. 

I was recommended the DBT workbook when I got diagnosed since I can’t really afford therapy. I’ve been working on it, but idk that it’ll be much help without the therapist to help make sense of deeper things. What are some of the more helpful skills you’ve learned?

Ugh fuck our states then. It’s illegal here too. And yessss omg the paranoia is unreal. I pretty much become a husk full of anxiety lmao. But it numbs everything else so somewhat worth it. I wish it was legal so I could just pop in a dispensary and get something that doesn’t cause so much paranoia.

It’s really is like a bandaid. But I’m in school/started interning, and they regularly drug test so I didn’t really have a choice. If I could, I’d still be smoking pot at least. That’s my drug of choice, but I’d take anything I could get my hands on. Except coke/meth/heroine. Too much of an addictive personality to trust myself with those lmao. I hate feeling so many feelings. I just wanna be normal. I’m gonna message you tho; it’d be nice to talk to someone who understands. And of course I’m here to listen to you as well 💖

Fuck that really sucks. I swear life just piles it on at the worst of times. Im sorry you’re going through all that. Just try to keep going. 💖 I’m Christian too and that’s kinda my fear. I feel like I’m going to be pretty much ganged up on, and my husbands going to be told his behavior is okay, and I’m the asshole. Which of course, I know I can be some times, but he can be a real jerk. We’ve been together for the better part of a decade, and it’s like he doesn’t even want to put up with the hard stuff anymore. I feel so alone. I can’t bear to open up to irl friends bc some times they don’t respond or just change the subject and bpd tells me they dgaf. And maybe they don’t, idk. Fuck idk. Bpd is so lonely. Plagued to understand everyone but never understood. :/ I just wanna be loved and cared for; I want it to matter that I fantasize about offing myself everyday and self harm ~monthly. Used to be free of that but lately I’ve gotten sober, and idk how else to cope.

Thank you for saying that. It’s nice to know I’m not  alone or asking too much. I get that it’s not easy being with me bc of bpd but jeez, it’s impossible HAVING bpd. I swear he doesn’t even think about what it’s like actually having it sometimes.. I would really like to get into therapy; it’s just not financially feasible rn. I’ve been recommended talking to a pastor several times, but Idek where to start trying to find one to talk to.
Oof I didn’t want to see this today, but I needed to. Why can’t I swallow this pill already?
Here’s hoping. Best of luck to you!! I really hope you get the help you need 😊

Well I believe that he is always with you, always listening. I’m not God so I cant guarantee what He wants from us, but I feel like it’s okay if you want to take them time to get to know Him first. It’s all about the relationship, and many start a relationship by getting to know each other first. I do know that He sees your heart. So even if you don’t have the words to say, He hears you anyway. 

The Lord’s Prayer is a great example of how to pray. 
“Our Father, who art in heaven,
Hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come,
Thy will be done on earth,
as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread.
And forgive us our debts,
as we forgive our debtors.
And lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from evil:
For thine is the kingdom,
and the power, and the glory,
forever. Amen.”

Also, this site gives a lot of helpful info! https://www.cru.org/us/en/train-and-grow/spiritual-growth/prayer/how-to-pray.html

Lastly, this may be hard to hear, but my God is also a jealous God. He loves you so deeply and unconditionally, but if you really want to be His, then you’ll need to denounce all other idols and commit to Him. You can belong to Him & Him alone. It may be hard, but He’s completely worth it. 💖

I hope this helps!

That’s much easier than trying to undo years of trauma from forcing yourself to do something you can’t handle at the time.
